topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: The lines on my skin, they whisper to me now, claiming parts of me as their own. I move through the world marked, not by my own will but by another's hand. Shadows seem to reach out, the silence louder than before. Each step feels heavier, the air thick with unseen weight. I must find the one who did this, understand why. The forest, once familiar, now feels like a maze, its paths leading me in circles, each turn bringing only more questions, more uncertainties. The markings throb, a pulse of intrusion I cannot escape.
